summary: Florida father and son's Jeep became stranded in ~2 ft of fresh snow west of the Engineer Pass summit (~12,800 ft) around 4:00 p.m.; call for help at 6:50 p.m.; SAR made contact by 9:45 p.m. and assisted both to safety
location: Engineer Pass, west of summit (~12,800 ft)
responding_agency: Hinsdale County SAR, San Juan County SAR, Ouray County SAR
notes:
Coordinated response across three county SAR teams after early-season snowstorm deteriorated conditions
